verses.sanskrit: वैशम्पायन उवाच । सा प्राद्रवत्काञ्चनमाल्यधारिणी ज्येष्ठेन भ्रात्रा प्रहिता यशस्विनी । सुदक्षिणा वेदिविलग्नमध्या सा पद्मपत्राभनिभा शिखण्डिनी ॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Dispatched by her elder brother, the illustrious daughter of the king of Matsya's, wearing a golden necklace, ever obedient, having a waist slender like that of a wasp, beautiful like Lakshmi, adorned with the plumes of a peacock, of a slender make, beautiful limbs, wearing a zone of pearls, graceful, having slightly curved eye-lashes, speedily went to the dancing-hall like a flash of lightning towards of clouds.
verses.bhavadeepa: नर्तनागृहम् ‘ण्यासश्रन्थो युच्’ इति ण्यन्ताद्युचि टाबन्तम् । सत्रेण छद्मना ॥२४॥

verses.sanskrit: तन्वी शुभाङ्गी मणिचित्रमेखला मत्स्यस्य राज्ञो दुहिता श्रिया वृता । तन्नर्तनागारमरालपक्ष्मा शतह्रदा मेघमिवान्वपद्यत ॥२॥
verses.bhavadeepa: सेति । माल्यं माला । ‘माल्यं कुसुमतत्स्रजोः’ इति मेदिनी । सुदक्षिणा भ्रातृच्छन्दानुवर्तिनी ‘दक्षिणा दक्षिणोद्भूतसरलच्छन्दवर्तिषु’ इति मेदिनी । वेदिवत् विलग्नः कृशो मध्यो यस्याः सा । पद्मपत्राभिनवा शिखण्डिनीति प्राचीनपाठः । पद्मपत्राभनिभा पद्मपत्रेषु आभातीति पद्मपत्राभा लक्ष्मीः तद्वत् निभा दीप्तिर्यस्याः सा । ये तु पद्मपत्राभं मरकतं तन्निभां श्यामामिति व्याचख्युः। तेषां कनकोज्ज्वलत्वचमिति वाक्यशेषेण विरोधः स्पष्टः । शिखण्डिनी मयूरपिच्छालङ्कारवती ॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: सा हस्तिहस्तोपमसंहितोरूः स्वनिन्दिता चारुदती सुमध्यमा । आसाद्य तं वै वरमाल्यधारिणी पार्थं शुभा नागवधूरिव द्विपम् ॥३॥
verses.english: That blameless, youthful (daughter of Virata) having beautiful teeth, and thighs close like the trunk of an elephant and wearing an excellent garland, she sought for Partha like a she-elephant seeking an elephant.

verses.sanskrit: सा रत्नभूता मनसः प्रियाऽर्चिता सुता विराटस्य यथेन्द्रलक्ष्मीः । सुदर्शनीया प्रमुखे यशस्विनी प्रीत्याऽब्रवीदर्जुनमायतेक्षणा ॥४॥
verses.english: That beautiful and illustrious daughter having large eyes, like a precious jem, or the prosperity of Indra, delightedly said to Arjuna.

verses.sanskrit: सुसंहतोरुं कनकोज्ज्वलत्त्वचं पार्थः कुमारीं स तदाऽभ्यभाषत । किमागमः काञ्चनमाल्यधारिणि मृगाक्षि किं त्वं त्वरितेव भामिनि । किं ते मुखं सुन्दरि न प्रसन्नमाचक्ष्व तत्त्वं मम शीघ्रमङ्गने ॥५॥
verses.english: Partha asked the Princess of close thighs and golden hue saying: "Why have you come here, O you wearing a golden garland? Why are you in a hurry, O you having the eyes of a deer? O fair lady, why your face is so cheerless? Tell me all this quickly.

verses.sanskrit: वैशम्पायन उवाच । स तां दृष्ट्वा विशालाक्षीं राजपुत्रीं सखीं तथा । प्रहसन्नब्रवीद्राजन् किमागमनमित्युत ॥६॥
verses.english: Beholding his friend the princess of expansive eyes in that condition, her friend (Arjuna) o king, smilingly asked her of the cause of coming.

verses.sanskrit: तमब्रवीद्राजपुत्री समुपेत्य नरर्षभम् । प्रणयं भावयन्ती सा सखीमध्य इदं वचः ॥७॥
verses.english: Then approaching that best of men, that princess, bending low with humility addressed to him (the following) words in the midst of her companions.

verses.sanskrit: गावो राष्ट्रस्य कुरुभिः काल्यन्ते नो बृहन्नले । ता विजेतुं मम भ्राता प्रयास्यति धनुर्धरः ॥८॥
verses.english: O Brihannala, the kine of this kingdom are being carried away by the Kurus; my brother is about to start for their discomfiture, with bow in hand.

verses.sanskrit: नाचिरं निहतस्तस्य संग्रामे रथसारथिः । तेन नास्ति समः सूतो योऽस्य सारथ्यमाचरेत् ॥९॥
verses.english: Very recently the charioteer of his car was slain in battle; there is none equal to him who can act as his (my brother's) charioteer.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मै प्रयतमानाय सारथ्यर्थं बृहन्नले । आचचक्षे हयज्ञाने सैरन्ध्री कौशलं तव ॥१०॥
verses.english: O Brihannala, while he was trying to find out a charioteer, Sairandhri spoke to him about your skill in the management of horses.

verses.sanskrit: अर्जुनस्य किलासीस्त्वं सारथिर्दयितः पुरा । त्वयाऽजयत्सहायेन पृथिवीं पाण्डवर्षभः ॥११॥
verses.english: By your help, that foremost of the Pandavas conquered the world. Brihannala replied to the prince who had said this.

verses.sanskrit: सा सारथ्यं मम भ्रातुः कुरु साधु बृहन्न । पुरा दूरतरं गावो ह्रियन्ते कुरुभिर्हि नः ॥१२॥
verses.english: Our kine (by this time) have been taken away to a greater distance by the Kurus. If you do not comply with my words as requested.

verses.sanskrit: अथैतद्वचनं मेऽद्य नियुक्ता न करिष्यसि । प्रणयादुच्यमाना त्वं परित्यक्ष्यामि जीवितम्॥१३॥
verses.english: I, who have asked you for this, shall give up my life. Being thus accosted by his friend of fair hips, that slayer of foes,
verses.bhavadeepa: यावत् गावो दूरतरं ह्रियन्ते ततः प्रागेव सारथ्यं कुरु ॥१२॥

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तु सुश्रोण्या तया सख्या परंतपः । जगाम राजपुत्रस्य सकाशममितौजसः ॥१४॥
verses.english: Of incomparable energy went to the prince. The large eyed (princess) followed him who was proceeding quickly like an elephant in rut as a she-elephant runs after its young one. Seeing him from a distance the prince said.

verses.sanskrit: तमाव्रजन्तं त्वरितं प्रभिन्नमिव कुञ्जरम् । अन्वगच्छद्विशालाक्षी शिशुं गजवधूरिव ॥१५॥
दूरादेव तु तां प्रेक्ष्य राजपुत्राऽभ्यभाषत । त्वया सारथिना पार्थः खाण्डवेऽग्निमतर्पयेत् ॥१६॥
verses.english: Having got you as his charioteer, Kunti's son Partha, the conqueror of the god of riches, offered oblation to Khandava fire and completely subjugated the world.

verses.sanskrit: पृथिवीमजयत् कृत्स्नां कुन्तीपुत्रो धनञ्जयः । सैरन्ध्री त्वां समाचष्टे सा हि जानाति पाण्डवान् ॥१७॥
verses.english: Sairandhri spoke of you to me; she knows the Pandavas; O Brihannala, govern in the same way, my horses,

verses.sanskrit: संयच्छ मामकानश्वांस्तथैव त्वं बृहन्नले । कुरुभिर्योत्स्यमानस्य गोधनानि परीप्सतः ॥१८॥
verses.english: Who am desirous of fighting with the Kurus and rescuing the precious kine. You were formerly the favourite charioteer of Arjuna.

verses.sanskrit: अर्जुनस्य किलासीस्त्वं सारथिर्दयितः पुरा । त्वयाऽजयत् सहायेन पृथिवीं पाण्डवर्षभः ॥१९॥
एवमुक्ता प्रत्युवाच राजपुत्रं बृहन्नला । का शक्तिर्मम सारथ्यं कर्तुं सङ्ग्राममूर्धनि ॥२०॥
verses.english: (Saying): “What power have I that I can act as your charioteer in the field of battle. If it were singing, dancing, musical instruments or any other similar thing I could have entertained you. But how can I work as a charioteer?”

verses.sanskrit: गीतं वा यदि वा नृत्यं वादित्रं वा पृथग्विधम् । तत् करिष्यामि भद्रं ते सारथ्यं तु कुतो मम ॥२१॥
उत्तर उवाच । बृहन्नले गायनो वा नर्तनो वा पुनर्भव । क्षिप्रं मे रथमास्थाय निगृह्णीष्व हयोत्तमान् ॥२२॥
verses.english: Uttara said O Brihannala, a singer or a dancer, whatever you may be, quickly ascend my chariot and restrain the best of horses.

verses.sanskrit: वैशम्पायन उवाच । स तत्र नर्मसंयुक्तमकरोत् पाण्डवो बहु । उत्तरायाः प्रमुखतः सर्वं जानन्नरिन्दमः ॥२३॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Although knowing everything, that slayer of foes, the son of Pandu, as if to make a fun, committed many mistakes before Uttara.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वमुत्क्षिप्य कवचं शरीरे प्रत्यमुञ्चत । कुमार्यस्तत्र तं दृष्ट्वा प्राहसन् पृथुलोचनाः ॥२४॥
verses.english: And while by raising it upwards he tried to put the coat of mail on his body, the large-eyed maidens, seeing it, began to laugh.

verses.sanskrit: स तु दृष्ट्वा विमुह्यन्तं स्वयमेवोत्तरस्ततः । कवचेन महार्हेण समनह्यद्बृहन्नलाम् ॥२५॥
verses.english: Beholding him bewildered Uttara himself dressed Brihannala with a highly precious coat of mail.

verses.sanskrit: स बिभ्रत्कवचं चाग्र्यं स्वयमप्यंशुमत्प्रभम् । ध्वजं च सिंहमुच्छ्रित्य सारथ्ये समकल्पयत् ॥२६॥
verses.english: Himself putting on an armour effulgent like the sun and hoisting the lion flag he appointed him (Brihannala, as his charioteer).

verses.sanskrit: धनूंषि च महार्हाणि बाणांश्च रुचिरान् बहून् । आदाय प्रययौ वीरः स बृहन्नलसारथिः ॥२७॥
verses.english: With Brihannala as his charioteer and taking many costly bows and beautiful arrows the hero issued out.

verses.sanskrit: अथोत्तरा च कन्याश्च सख्यस्तामब्रुवंस्तदा । बृहन्नले आनयेथा वासांसि रुचिराणि च ॥२८॥
verses.english: His friend Uttara and other maidens then said:-"O Brihannala, bring for our dolls fine, beautiful and soft cloths of various kinds (when you will come back) after defeating the Kurus in battle headed by Bhishma and Drona.”

verses.sanskrit: पाञ्चालिकार्थं चित्राणि सूक्ष्माणि च मृदूनि च । विजित्य संग्रामगतान् भीष्मद्रोणमुखान् कुरून् ॥२९॥
एवं ता ब्रुवतीः कन्याः सहिताः पाण्डुनन्दनः । प्रत्युवाच हसन् पार्थो मेघदुन्दुभिनिःस्वनः ॥३०॥
verses.english: The maidens thus speaking, Partha, the son of Pandu, smilingly replied in words deep as the muttering of clouds.

verses.sanskrit: बृहन्नलोवाच । यद्युत्तरोऽयं संग्रामे विजेष्यति महारथान् । अथाहरिष्ये वासांसि दिव्यानि रुचिराणि च ॥३१॥
verses.english: Brihannala said If Uttara can defeat those mighty carwarriors I shall bring many beautiful clothes for you.

verses.sanskrit: वैशम्पायन उवाच । एवमुक्त्वा तु बीभत्सुस्ततः प्राचोदयद्धयान् । कुरूनभिमुखः शूरो नानाध्वजपताकिनः ॥३२॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Having said this the heroic Arjuna drove the horses towards the Kuru army over which were flowing many flags.

verses.sanskrit: तमुत्तरं वीक्ष्य रथोत्तमे स्थितं बृहन्नलायाः सहितं महाभुजम् । स्त्रियश्च कन्याश्च द्विजाश्च सुव्रताः प्रदक्षिणं चक्रुरथोचुरङ्गनाः ॥३३॥
verses.english: Beholding the mighty-armed Uttara seated on the excellent car along with Brihannala, the females, the maidens and the Brahmanas of hard vows, went round the car.

verses.sanskrit: यदर्जुनस्यर्षभतुल्यगामिनः पुराऽभवत् खाण्डवदाहमङ्गलम् । कुरून् समासाद्य रणे बृहन्नले सहोत्तरेणाद्य तदस्तु मङ्गलम् ॥३४॥
verses.english: "(They said) 0 Brihannala, may that victory, which Arjuna, walking like a bull obtained in the days of yore at the time of the burning of the forest of Khandava, come to you today when you shall with Uttara meet the Kurus.
